O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your Noble Name and Your perfect words to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And to make me among Your freed and released ones from the Fire.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ اَلزُّرَارِيِّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :«اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ اَلْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ جَهْدِ اَلْبَلاَءِ وَ شَمَاتَةِ اَلْأَعْدَاءِ وَ سُوءِ اَلْقَضَاءِ وَ دَرَكِ اَلشَّقَاءِ وَ مِنَ اَلضَّرَرِ فِي اَلْمَعِيشَةِ وَأَنْ تَبْتَلِيَنِي بِبَلاَءٍ لاَ طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ أَوْ تُسَلِّطَ عَلَيَّ طَاغِياً أَوْ تَهْتِكَ لِي سِتْراً أَوْ تُبْدِيَ لِي عَوْرَةً أَوْ تُحَاسِبَنِي يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ مُنَاقِشاً أَحْوَجَ مَا أَكُونُ إِلَى عَفْوِكَ وَ تَجَاوُزِكَ عَنِّي فِيمَا سَلَفَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْكَرِيمِ وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ اَلتَّامَّةِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ وَ طُلَقَائِكَ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ»

items.e: Ali ibn Hatim, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from some who narrated it from Abu al-Hasan Musa (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), there is no God but You (azj). I worship none but You (azj), and I associate nothing with You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), ‘Indeed, I have wronged myself, so forgive me’ (Surah Al-Qasas 28:16), and have mercy on me, for indeed none forgives sins except You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And forgive me for what I have done before and what I will do later, what I have made public and what I have kept secret, and what You (azj) know better than I do. And You (azj) are the One who brings forward and the One who delays. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And guide me to justice, guidance, correctness, and the firm establishment of the religion. O’ Allah (swt), make me one who guides and is rightly guided, content and pleasing (to You (azj)), not astray and not leading others astray. O’ Allah (swt), Lord (azj) of the seven heavens and Lord (azj) of the seven earths and Lord (azj) of the Mighty Throne, suffice me in that which concerns me of my affairs, however You (azj) will and in whatever way You (azj) will, And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and his family (a.s),” Then supplicate with whatever you wish. (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then perform two units of prayer, and when you finish, say: “O’ Allah (swt), none can repel Your wrath except Your forbearance, And none can save from Your punishment except Your mercy, And none can deliver from Your chastisement except turning humbly to You (azj). So grant me, O’ my God, ‘a mercy from Yourself’ (Surah Al Imran 3:8), Through which You (azj) make me free of need for the mercy of anyone besides You (azj), By the power through which You (azj) revive the dead land, And by which You (azj) resurrect the dead among the servants, And do not destroy me with grief until You (azj) forgive me and have mercy on me, And make me recognize the answer to my supplication, And let me taste the sweetness of well-being until the end of my term. And do not allow my enemy to gloat over me, And do not give him control over my neck. My God (azj), if You (azj) lower me, then who is there to raise me? And if You (azj) raise me, then who is there to lower me? And if You (azj) destroy me, then who is there to stand between You (azj) and me, or to interfere with You (azj) in any matter of mine? And I have indeed known, O’ my God (azj), that there is no injustice in Your judgment, and there is no haste in Your punishment and only one who fears losing something hastens, and only the weak have need to commit injustice and You (azj), O’ my God, are exalted far above that, with great exaltation. So do not make me a target for affliction, nor a sign for Your vengeance. Grant me respite, grant me relief, overlook my slip, and do not try me with a trial following another trial for surely, You (azj) see my weakness and the lack of my means. I seek refuge in You (azj), O’ Allah (swt), so grant me refuge. I seek protection with You (azj) from the Fire, so protect me. And I ask You (azj) for Paradise, so do not deprive me of it.” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then you do two units of prayer, and when you finish, say: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed, Your pardon of my sin, And Your overlooking of my fault, And Your forgiveness of my wrongdoing, And Your covering over my disgraceful deeds, And Your forbearance despite the magnitude of my crimes whether they were committed in error or deliberately, has encouraged me to ask You (azj) for that which I do not deserve from You (azj): that which You (azj) have granted me from Your mercy, And made me acquainted with from Your responsiveness, and shown me from Your power. Thus I have begun calling upon You (azj) in safety, and asking You (azj) with familiarity, not in fear or dread, relying upon You (azj) in what I turn to You (azj) for. And if You (azj) delay in responding to me, I blame You (azj) out of my ignorance and perhaps what You (azj) delayed for me is better for me, due to Your knowledge of the outcome of matters. I have never seen a generous Master, more patient with a disgraceful servant, than You (azj) are with me. O’ my Lord (azj), indeed You (azj) call me, and I turn away from You (azj); And You (azj) show love toward me, but I become hostile toward You (azj); And You (azj) show affection toward me, but I do not accept it from You (azj) as though I have the upper hand over You (azj). Yet none of that prevents You (azj) from having mercy on me, doing good to me, and bestowing generously upon me out of Your bounty and generosity. So have mercy on Your ignorant servant, And bestow upon him from the excellence of Your kindness indeed, You (azj) are Generous and Noble.” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “And when you finish the supplication, go into prostration (sujud) and say in your prostration: ‘O’ the One (azj) who existed before everything, And the One (azj) who will exist after everything, And the One (azj) who brings all things into being do not expose me, for You (azj) know all about me, and do not punish me, for You (azj) have power over me. O’ Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You (azj) from turning away (from faith) at the time of death, And from the evil of the return to the graves, And from regret on the Day of Resurrection. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for a pleasant life, a peaceful death, and an honourable return; which is not disgraceful and not shameful.’”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ بَعْضِ مَنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لاَ أَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاكَ وَ لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِكَ شَيْئاً اَللَّهُمَّ« إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي» وَ اِرْحَمْنِي إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ اَلذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَ أَخَّرْتُ وَ أَعْلَنْتُ وَ أَسْرَرْتُ وَ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي وَ أَنْتَ اَلْمُقَدِّمُ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْمُؤَخِّرُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ دُلَّنِي عَلَى اَلْعَدْلِ وَ اَلْهُدَى وَاَلصَّوَابِ وَقِوَامِ اَلدِّينِ اَللَّهُمَّ اِجْعَلْنِي هَادِياً مَهْدِيّاً رَاضِياً مَرْضِيّاً غَيْرَ ضَالٍّ وَلاَ مُضِلٍّ اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ اَلسَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ اَلْأَرَضِينَ اَلسَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ اَلْعَرْشِ اَلْعَظِيمِ اِكْفِنِي اَلْمُهِمَّ مِنْ أَمْرِي بِمَا شِئْتَ وَ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اُدْعُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ يَا اَللَّهُ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلاَّ حِلْمُكَ وَ لاَ يُنْجِي مِنْ نَقِمَتِكَ إِلاَّ رَحْمَتُكَ وَ لاَ يُنْجِي مِنْ عَذَابِكَ إِلاَّ اَلتَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ فَهَبْ لِي يَا إِلَهِي« مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً» تُغْنِينِي بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ مَنْ سِوَاكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ اَلَّتِي بِهَا تُحْيِي مَيْتَ اَلْبِلاَدِ وَ بِهَا تَنْشُرُ مَيْتَ اَلْعِبَادِ وَ لاَ تُهْلِكْنِي غَمّاً حَتَّى تَغْفِرَ لِي وَ تَرْحَمَنِي وَ تُعَرِّفَنِي اَلاِسْتِجَابَةَ فِي دُعَائِي وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ اَلْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي وَ لاَ تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوِّي وَ لاَ تُمَكِّنْهُ مِنْ رَقَبَتِي إِلَهِي إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا اَلَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِي وَ إِنْ رَفَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا اَلَّذِي يَضَعُنِي وَ إِنْ أَهْلَكْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا اَلَّذِي يَحُولُ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنِي أَوْ يَتَعَرَّضُ لَكَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِي وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ يَا إِلَهِي أَنْ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ وَ لاَ فِي نَقِمَتِكَ عَجَلَةٌ وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ اَلْفَوْتَ وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى اَلظُّلْمِ اَلضَّعِيفُ وَ قَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا إِلَهِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً فَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي لِلْبَلاَءِ غَرَضاً وَ لاَ لِنَقِمَتِكَ نَصَباً وَ مَهِّلْنِي وَ نَفِّسْنِي وَ أَقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي وَ لاَ تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِبَلاَءٍ عَلَى أَثَرِ بَلاَءٍ فَقَدْ تَرَى ضَعْفِي وَ قِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ يَا اَللَّهُ فَأَجِرْنِي وَ أَسْتَعِيذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ فَأَعِذْنِي وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اَلْجَنَّةَ فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي

items.e: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from al-Harith ibn Abi Rasan, from Burayd ibn Mu‘awiyah al-‘Ijli, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), said: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by the fact that all praise belongs to You (azj). There is no God but You (azj), the Bestower, ‘Originator of the heavens and the earth, Possessor of Majesty and Generosity’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:117), Indeed, I am a needy supplicant, a fearful one seeking refuge, a repentant one seeking forgiveness. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And forgive me all of my sins the old and the recent, and every sin I have committed. O’ Allah (swt), do not make my affliction severe, And do not allow my enemies to rejoice over me, for there is no repeller and no withholder except You (azj).”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْحَارِثِ بْنِ أَبِي رَسَنٍ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ اَلْحَمْدَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ اَلْمَنَّانُ« بَدِيعُ اَلسَّمٰاوٰاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضِ»« ذُو اَلْجَلاٰلِ وَ اَلْإِكْرٰامِ» إِنِّي سَائِلٌ فَقِيرٌ وَ خَائِفٌ مُسْتَجِيرٌ وَ تَائِبٌ مُسْتَغْفِرٌ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي كُلَّهَا قَدِيمَهَا وَ حَدِيثَهَا وَ كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُجْهِدْ بَلاَئِي وَ لاَ تُشْمِتْ بِي أَعْدَائِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ دَافِعَ وَ لاَ مَانِعَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ».

items.e: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sahl ibn Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for faith that penetrates my heart, And for true certainty such that all doubt is removed from me until I know that nothing will befall me except what You (azj) have decreed for me, And contentment with what You (azj) have apportioned for me. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for a pure soul that believes in meeting You (azj), is content with Your gift, and is pleased with Your decree. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for a faith that has no end except in meeting You (azj), Take charge of me as long as You (azj) keep me alive upon it, And let me live as long as You (azj) give me life upon it, And cause me to die when You (azj) cause me to die upon it, And resurrect me when You (azj) resurrect me upon it, And cleanse my chest through it from doubt and uncertainty in my religion.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ اَلْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَاناً تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَ يَقِيناً صَادِقاً حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ بِالشَّكِّ عَنِّي حَتَّى أَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُصِيبَنِي إِلاَّ مَا كَتَبْتَ لِي وَاَلرِّضَا بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ نَفْساً طَيِّبَةً تُؤْمِنُ بِلِقَائِكَ وَ تَقْنَعُ بِعَطَائِكَ وَ تَرْضَى بِقَضَائِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَاناً لاَ أَجَلَ لَهُ دُونَ لِقَائِكَ تَوَلَّنِي مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ تُحْيِينِي مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ تَوَفَّنِي إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ تَبْعَثُنِي إِذَا بَعَثْتَنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ تُبْرِئُ بِهِ صَدْرِي مِنَ اَلشَّكِّ وَ اَلرَّيْبِ فِي دِينِي»

items.e: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, who raised it (in isnad) to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Forbearing, O’ Generous, O’ All-Knowing, O’ All-Aware, O’ All-Powerful, O’ All-Dominant, O’ All-Acquainted, O’ Subtle One, O’ Allah (swt), O’ my Lord (azj), O’ my Master, O’ my Protector, O’ my Hope. I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And I ask You (azj) for a breath from Your noble, merciful breaths by which You (azj) gather my scattered affairs, set right my condition, settle my debt, revive me and my dependents, and make me independent of all others besides You (azj). O’ You (azj), who are better for me than my father and my mother and all people altogether, Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And do that for me this very hour indeed, You (azj) have power over all things.” (Imam (a.s) then continued) “Then do two units of prayer, and when finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed seeking forgiveness while persisting (in sin) is meanness, And my refraining from seeking forgiveness despite my knowledge of Your generosity is weakness. How often do You (azj) show affection to me through blessings despite Your being free of need from me, And how often do I turn away from You (azj) through sins, despite my destitute poverty before You (azj). O’ You (azj) who, when He (azj) promises, fulfills, and when He (azj) threatens, pardons, Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And choose for me the better of the two matters with You (azj), for indeed forgiveness is of Your nature, and You (azj) are the Most Merciful of the merciful. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by the sanctity of the one who sought refuge in You (azj) from You (azj), and turned to Your might, and took shelter in Your shade, and held fast to Your rope. O’ Abundant Giver of gifts, O’ Liberator of the captives, O’ He (azj) who named Himself, out of His (azj) generosity, O’ ‘al-Wahhab’ (the Ever-Bestower). Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), and appoint for me, O’ my Master, relief and a way out from my affair, And expansive sustenance as You (azj) will, in whatever manner You (azj) will, by whatever means You (azj) will, and from wherever You (azj) will for indeed, what You (azj) will comes to be, when You (azj) will, in the way You (azj) will.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« يَا حَلِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا عَالِمُ يَا عَلِيمُ يَا قَادِرُ يَا قَاهِرُ يَا خَبِيرُ يَا لَطِيفُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا رَبَّاهْ يَا سَيِّدَاهْ يَا مَوْلاَهْ يَا رَجَاءَاهْ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ نَفْحَةً مِنْ نَفَحَاتِكَ كَرِيمَةً رَحِيمَةً تَلُمُّ بِهَا شَعْثِي وَ تُصْلِحُ بِهَا شَأْنِي وَ تَقْضِي بِهَا دَيْنِي وَ تَنْعَشُنِي بِهَا وَ عِيَالِي وَ تُغْنِينِي بِهَا عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ يَا مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لِي مِنْ أَبِي وَ أُمِّي وَ مِنَ اَلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ بِيَ اَلسَّاعَةَ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ اَلاِسْتِغْفَارَ مَعَ اَلْإِصْرَارِ لُؤْمٌ وَ تَرْكِيَ اَلاِسْتِغْفَارَ مَعَ مَعْرِفَتِي بِكَرَمِكَ عَجْزٌ فَكَمْ تَتَحَبَّبُ إِلَيَّ بِالنِّعَمِ مَعَ غِنَاكَ عَنِّي وَ أَتَبَغَّضُ إِلَيْكَ بِالْمَعَاصِي مَعَ فَقْرِي إِلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ إِذَا وَعَدَ وَفَى وَ إِذَا تَوَعَّدَ عَفَا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِفْعَلْ بِي أَوْلَى اَلْأَمْرَيْنِ بِكَ فَإِنَّ مِنْ شَأْنِكَ اَلْعَفْوَ وَ أَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ اَلرَّاحِمِينَ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ عَاذَبِكَ مِنْكَ وَ لَجَأَ إِلَى عِزِّكَ وَ اِسْتَظَلَّ بِفَيْئِكَ وَ اِعْتَصَمَ بِحَبْلِكَ يَا جَزِيلَ اَلْعَطَايَا يَا فَكَّاكَ اَلْأُسَارَى يَا مَنْ سَمَّى نَفْسَهُ مِنْ جُودِهِ اَلْوَهَّابَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلْ لِي يَا مَوْلاَيَ مِنْ أَمْرِي فَرَجاً وَ مَخْرَجاً وَ رِزْقاً وَاسِعاً كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ أَنَّى شِئْتَ وَ بِمَا شِئْتَ وَ حَيْثُ شِئْتَ فَإِنَّهُ يَكُونُ مَا شِئْتَ إِذَا شِئْتَ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ»

items.e: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from al-Husayn ibn Sayf, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from Ibrahim ibn al-Fadl, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your Name that is inscribed in the pavilion of Glory, And I ask You (azj) by Your Name that is inscribed in the pavilion of Splendor, And I ask You (azj) by Your Name that is inscribed in the pavilion of Magnificence, And I ask You (azj) by Your Name that is inscribed in the pavilion of Majesty, And I ask You (azj) by Your Name that is inscribed in the pavilion of Might, And I ask You (azj) by Your Name that is inscribed in the pavilion of Power, And I ask You (azj) by Your Name that is inscribed in the pavilion of the Hidden Secrets, The Preceding, the Transcendent, the Beautiful, the Radiant Lord (azj) of the eight angels who bear the Throne. And Lord (azj) of the Great Throne, and by the Eye that does not sleep, And by the Greatest, the Greatest Name, And by the Most Supreme, Most Supreme Name, that encompasses the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, And by the Name through which the heavens and the earth were illuminated, And by the Name through which the sun shone and the moon gave its light, And by the Name through which the seas were filled and the mountains were erected, And by the Name through which the Throne and the Footstool were established. And by Your honored, sanctified, concealed, and treasured Names in the knowledge of the unseen with You (azj), I ask You (azj) by all of that, to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws)” And then supplicate with whatever you desire. When you have completed your supplication, then prostrate and say: “My lowly face has prostrated to the Noble Face of my Lord (azj). My insignificant face has prostrated to the Mighty, Noble Face of my Lord (azj). O’ Generous One, O’ Generous One, O’ Generous One, By Your generosity and bounty, forgive me my wrong, my crime, and my excess upon myself.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَيْفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْمَكْتُوبِ فِي سُرَادِقِ اَلْمَجْدِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْمَكْتُوبِ فِي سُرَادِقِ اَلْبَهَاءِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْمَكْتُوبِ فِي سُرَادِقِ اَلْعَظَمَةِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْمَكْتُوبِ فِي سُرَادِقِ اَلْجَلاَلِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْمَكْتُوبِ فِي سُرَادِقِ اَلْعِزَّةِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْمَكْتُوبِ فِي سُرَادِقِ اَلْقُدْرَةِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ اَلْمَكْتُوبِ في سرادق السرائر اَلسَّابِقِ اَلْفَائِقِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلنَّضِرِ رَبِّ اَلْمَلاَئِكَةِ اَلثَّمَانِيَةِ وَ رَبِّ اَلْعَرْشِ اَلْعَظِيمِ وَ بِالْعَيْنِ اَلَّتِي لاَ تَنَامُ وَ بِالاِسْمِ اَلْأَكْبَرِ اَلْأَكْبَرِ وَ بِالاِسْمِ اَلْأَعْظَمِ اَلْأَعْظَمِ اَلْمُحِيطِ بِمَلَكُوتِ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضِ وَ بِالاِسْمِ اَلَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ لَهُ اَلسَّمَاوَاتُ وَ اَلْأَرْضُ وَ بِالاِسْمِ اَلَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ أَضَاءَ بِهِ اَلْقَمَرُ وَ سُجِّرَتْ بِهِ اَلْبِحَارُ وَ نُصِبَتْ بِهِ اَلْجِبَالُ وَ بِالاِسْمِ اَلَّذِي قَامَ بِهِ اَلْعَرْشُ وَ اَلْكُرْسِيُّ وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ اَلْمُكَرَّمَاتِ اَلْمُقَدَّسَاتِ اَلْمَكْنُونَاتِ اَلْمَخْزُونَاتِ فِي عِلْمِ اَلْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ تَدْعُو بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ

items.e: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah and Ali ibn Sulayman both said: Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated to us, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)) peace be upon them, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “O’ Allah (swt), to You (azj) belongs all praise with all of Your praises for all of Your blessings, until the praise reaches that which You (azj) love and are pleased with. O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for Your goodness and the goodness of what I hope for, And I seek refuge in You (azj) from the evil of what I fear and from the evil of what I do not fear. O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And expand my sustenance, and extend my life, and forgive my sin, and make me among those through whom You (azj) support Your religion, and do not replace me with someone else.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), And apportion for us, of Your fear, that which acts as a barrier between us and Your disobedience; And of Your obedience, that which will deliver us to Your Paradise; And of certainty, that which makes the afflictions of this world easy upon us. And allow us to enjoy our hearing and our sight, and grant us victory over those who show enmity to us. And do not make our affliction in our religion, and do not make this world the greatest of our concerns, and do not give power over us to those who will not show us mercy.” Then perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say: “O’ Allah (swt), indeed my sins cause me to fear You (azj), and Your generosity gives me hope from You (azj). So, by fear, remove me from sins, and by Your bounty, bring me to gifts, until I may be tomorrow on the Day of Resurrection a freed one by Your generosity, just as I was in the world a nurtured one of Your blessings. For what You (azj) will bestow tomorrow of salvation is not greater than what You (azj) have granted today of hope. And when has one who hoped at Your door ever been disappointed? Or when has one who asked of You (azj) ever been turned away rejected? My God (azj), never has one called upon You (azj), whom You (azj) did not answer for You (azj) have said: ‘Call upon Me, I will respond to you’ (Surah al-Mu’min 40:60), And You (azj) do not break the promise. So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), O’ my God (azj), and answer my supplication.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ اَلْحَمْدُ بِمَحَامِدِكَ كُلِّهَا عَلَى نَعْمَائِكَ كُلِّهَا حَتَّى يَنْتَهِيَ اَلْحَمْدُ إِلَى مَا تُحِبُّ وَ تَرْضَى اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَكَ وَ خَيْرَ مَا أَرْجُو وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَحْذَرُ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا لاَ أَحْذَرُ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَوْسِعْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي وَ اُمْدُدْ لِي فِي عُمُرِي وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَاِجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ تَنْتَصِرُ بِهِ لِدِينِكَ وَ لاَ تَسْتَبْدِلْ بِي غَيْرِي ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ وَ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ وَ مِنَ اَلْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ اَلدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَاُنْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَ لاَ تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا وَ لاَ تَجْعَلِ اَلدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَ لاَ تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُنَا ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ ذُنُوبِي تُخَوِّفُنِي مِنْكَ وَ جُودَكَ يُبَشِّرُنِي عَنْكَ فَأَخْرِجْنِي بِالْخَوْفِ مِنَ اَلْخَطَايَا وَ أَوْصِلْنِي بِجُودِكَ إِلَى اَلْعَطَايَا حَتَّى أَكُونَ غَداً فِي اَلْقِيَامَةِ عَتِيقَ كَرَمِكَ كَمَا كُنْتُ فِي اَلدُّنْيَا رَبِيبَ نِعَمِكَ فَلَيْسَ مَا تَبْذُلُهُ غَداً مِنَ اَلنَّجَاةِ بِأَعْظَمَ مِمَّا قَدْ مَنَحْتَهُ اَلْيَوْمَ مِنَ اَلرَّجَاءِ وَمَتَى خَابَ فِي فِنَائِكَ آمِلٌ أَمْ مَتَى اِنْصَرَفَ عَنْكَ بِالرَّدِّ سَائِلٌ إِلَهِي مَا دَعَاكَ مَنْ لَمْ تُجِبْهُ لِأَنَّكَ قُلْتَ« اُدْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ» وَ أَنْتَ« لاٰ تُخْلِفُ اَلْمِيعٰادَ» فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ يَا إِلَهِي وَ اِسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِي»
